label: g1152-canon12b-n2
_why: TWO CENTURIES OF THE MOD 1.2 CANON g1152-canon12b (§10.132, canonised 2026-11-23 before its runs): g1152-canon12 + A 2.2 -> 2.35, the crafts at 30 points (cost divisor 50 -> 10), the five mines, gold, fishing and whaling at 0.75x cost on every rung. The user, 2026-11-23: "Go with n=2 on the newest book." A fixed-n batch: both runs play to 1936.

_arms.canon: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.g1152-canon12b.json} - THE CANON (sha256 2b4ec38a24535e0a, tree twin 36f9a19ddfb3fdfd), a verbatim copy in config/mod_config.json; nothing a build reads changed since 5cfa1e17.

_comparison: The register against vanilla 1.15.2 (n=8, F274) beside g1152-canon12 (n=5, F289) and m12b-first (n=5, F283/F284); the ledger; the technology census, misplaced capital, red flags, old rungs, crafts built per decade, the deposits' levels and payback, the wall clock in clusters (directional: no alternating vanilla, §3.4).

_predictions.note: Written before run 1. The A move by F165's lever readings (game 1.13 books, A 2.0-2.2: an extrapolation, magnitude argued only loosely); the deposit and craft changes by F290's static paybacks (direction only).
_predictions.world_gdp: Up from g1152-canon12's 0.61x vanilla 1.15.2: about 0.80x (0.72-0.88) at the end, under the 0.90-1.00 aim; plausibly still under vanilla's lowest run (0.89x) in at least one of the two.
_predictions.depeasantation: U* lower than canon12's (world 60.0%, Britain 27.5%, Germany 64.9% at the end), still above every aim.
_predictions.barrier: Not past in either run; the hoard stays small (F165: about x1.27 per +10% GDP from a low base).
_predictions.crafts: Far fewer craft levels built after about 1866 than in canon12; T0 lower from 1880 on.
_predictions.deposits: More mine and fishing levels than canon12; coal, iron and fish prices back toward vanilla's.
_predictions.prices: The industry-output aggregate's 1935 / 1900 lower than canon12's (more frontier output).
_predictions.military: No tech-era-5 military technology in either run.
_predictions.play_time: Cluster 1, 150-180 min a run (a larger economy than canon12's 150 min).

_stop_rule: None: a fixed-n batch, every run plays to 1936.
_cost: 2 x 1836 -> 1936, about 2 h 30 min - 3 h each: about 5-6 hours.
